chunks: When you wish to stand for salat al-layl, then say: O Allah, I turn toward You through Your Prophet, the Prophet of mercy, and his family, and I place them before my needs, so make me through them...
"honored in this world and the Hereafter, and among those brought near."

O Allah, have mercy on me through them and do not punish me through them; guide me through them and do not lead me astray through them; provide for me through them and do not deprive me through them; and fulfill my needs for this world and the Hereafter.
"Indeed, You are Powerful over all things" and "Knowing of all things."

key_terms.قَدِيرٌ: all-powerful, fully able over every thing
key_terms.نَبِيِّ الرَّحْمَةِ: the Prophet characterized by divine mercy
key_terms.وَجِيهًا: honored and held in worthy regard

ai.seo_question: What supplication should be recited when standing for the night prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a supplication to be recited when rising for salat al-layl, seeking nearness to Allah through the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and his family. It asks for mercy, guidance, sustenance, and the fulfillment of worldly and otherworldly needs, while affirming Allah’s absolute power and knowledge.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1398 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"When you wish to stand for the night prayer, say:
'O’ Allah (swt), I turn to You by Your Prophet, the Prophet of Mercy, and his family, and I present them before my needs. Make me, through them,
'honorable in this world and the Hereafter, and among those brought near (to You).'

‘ O’ Allah (swt), have mercy on me through them, do not punish me through them, guide me through them, do not lead me astray through them, provide for me through them, and do not deprive me through them. Fulfil my needs for this world and the Hereafter,
for indeed, You have power over all things and You have knowledge of all things.'"
